answer_1.quote: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has underscored the importance of evaluating their alignment with human intent in generated responses, making it an active field of research.
answer_1.outputs: The generated responses from AI assistants in a dialogue setting are evaluated based on helpfulness, relevance, accuracy, and level of detail.

answer_2.quote: Traditional n-gram metrics like BLEU and ROUGE, as well as more sophisticated model-based evaluations such as BERTScore and BARTScore, are insufficient for thoroughly assessing this alignment.

answer_3.quote: The evaluation pipeline of Vicuna has gained significant interest and wide usage due to its simplicity and interpretability. It prompts GPT-4 to score and compare candidate responses and provide explanations, making it a valuable tool for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: To assess the effectiveness of our proposed strategies, three of the authors manually annotate the "win/tie/lose" outcomes of responses from Chat-GPT and Vicuna-13B independently in all 80 Vicuna Benchmark questions.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators are instructed to assess the responses provided by Vicuna-13B and Chat-GPT from four different perspectives: helpfulness, relevance, accuracy, and level of detail.
